NEW EMPLOYEE EXPERIENCE

Your journey starts here.

Your first day, your first week and the milestones ahead. Check off each setup task to see your demo progress update.

Day one, step by step

01

Morning

Meet your colleagues, get familiar with the workplace, and sign the required work handover documents and complete your fingerprint creation.

02

Afternoon

Get your laptop and work accounts ready, learn how the team operates, and get introduced to our projects — all while enjoying your first coffee with the team!

03

End of day

Make sure you have everything you need to get started. We’re excited to have you on the team and look forward to achieving great things together!

EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK

Policies & benefits.

A clear guide to everyday work arrangements, leave, conduct and the benefits described in the employee handbook.

◷ Working hours & attendance

  • 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, including a 30-minute break.
  • One flexible hour between 8 and 9 AM.

⌁ Permissions

  • 2-hour excuse per month.

▦ Leave

  • Annual: 21.5 days in the first year, 30 days after one year.
  • Casual: 7 days.

♧ Code of conduct

  • Dress code: casual.
  • Work as one team.
  • Anti-harassment: maintain professionalism.

◈ Salary calculation

  • Calculated up to the 25th of each month.

✧ Team outings

  • Company outings every few months to recharge, connect and enjoy time together beyond work.

♡ Healthy work environment

A supportive culture that values employee well-being and work-life balance.
